description: Commit 28 — Payments and audit log views at a single /dashboard/admin/payments page. Two tabs: 'Payments' (paginated list of all payments using the existing paymentsApi.adminList or a new adminApi.payments endpoint) and 'Audit log' (paginated list of AuditLog entries). Both are read-only tables. Independent from FEAT-002/003 in terms of UI; depends on FEAT-002 having created src/app/actions/admin.ts for the adminToken pattern.
steps: 1. Extend src/lib/admin.ts: add two more list methods. Import `AuditLog, Payment` — both already exist in src/types/index.ts. Add: `payments: (token: string, query?: { page?: number; limit?: number }) => apiPaginated<Payment[]>('/admin/payments', { token, cache: 'no-store', query })` and `auditLog: (token: string, query?: { page?: number; limit?: number }) => apiPaginated<AuditLog[]>('/admin/audit', { token, cache: 'no-store', query })`. Keep all existing methods unchanged.

2. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/payments/page.tsx as an async Server Component. Metadata `{ title: 'Payments & audit log' }`. Parse `tab` ('payments' | 'audit', default 'payments') and `page` (default 1) from searchParams (typed as `Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>`). Fetch based on tab: if `tab === 'payments'`, call `adminApi.payments(token, { page, limit: 20 })`; if `tab === 'audit'`, call `adminApi.auditLog(token, { page, limit: 20 })`. Store result as `{ data, meta }`. Render: Eyebrow 'Financials & audit' + h1 'Payments & audit log'. Two tab buttons ('Payments' / 'Audit log') rendered as `<ButtonLink>` pointing to `?tab=payments` / `?tab=audit` with `variant={active ? 'soft' : 'ghost'} size='sm'`. Below tabs, conditionally render either the payments list or the audit list with pagination. Import `adminApi` from `@/lib/admin`, `getSession` from `@/lib/session`, `ButtonLink` from `@/components/ui/button`, `Eyebrow` from `@/components/ui/eyebrow`, `formatCurrency, formatDate, formatDateTime` from `@/lib/format`.

3. For the Payments tab: render a list of payment rows inside the same page component (no separate client component needed — read-only). Each row: `
`. Left: user email (`payment.user?.email ?? payment.userId`), purpose badge (PLATFORM_DONATION → `bg-blush text-blood`, EMERGENCY_FUND → `bg-sand text-sand-deep`) using the `` component from `@/components/ui/badge`, date (`formatDate(payment.createdAt)`). Right: amount `

{formatCurrency(payment.amount, payment.currency)}

`, status badge (PAID → `bg-mint text-forest`; PENDING → `bg-sand text-sand-deep`; FAILED → `bg-linen text-ink-muted`) using ``. Empty state: 'No payments yet.'

4. For the Audit log tab: render audit log rows inline. Each row: `
`. Actor email (`log.actor.email`), action string in a monospace `{log.action}`, target type + id (`log.targetType + ' ' + log.targetId` in text-xs text-ink-faint), timestamp `formatDateTime(log.createdAt)`. Empty state: 'No audit entries.'

5. Add pagination for both tabs: after the list, show total count as `

{meta.total} {tab === 'audit' ? 'entries' : 'payments'}

` and Prev/Next `` pointing to `?tab=...&page=N` (hide Prev on page 1, hide Next when page >= totalPages).

6. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/payments/loading.tsx: export default `PaymentsLoading()` with `Loading payments…` and 8 row skeletons: `
`.
7. Commit: `git add src/lib/admin.ts src/app/dashboard/admin/payments/ && git commit -m 'feat: add payments and audit log views'`
